qs.q: A patient with a deficiency in lipoprotein lipase (LPL) would exhibit elevated levels of which type of lipoprotein in their plasma?
qs.e: Lipoprotein lipase hydrolyzes triglycerides in chylomicrons and VLDL; its deficiency leads to accumulation of these triglyceride-rich lipoproteins.
